name: Pass Panel Opened
description: User opens the ISS pass times panel for their location.

name: Observer Location Set
description: User sets observer location via GPS or city search, capturing method and any errors.

name: Observer Location Cleared
description: User clears their observer location from the pass panel.

name: Pass Times Viewed
description: User sees the list of upcoming ISS visible passes for their location.

name: Globe Drag Started
description: User begins manually dragging/rotating the 3D globe.

name: Globe Recentred
description: User clicks the Re-centre button to snap the globe back to the ISS.

name: Units Changed
description: User toggles between imperial and metric units.

name: Location Clicked
description: User clicks the Learn More link for the place below the ISS.

name: ISS Data Error Encountered
description: ISS telemetry feed fails and the app enters an error state.
